newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at thin levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted at thin levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were traded at thin levels on Friday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus 15 barges traded Thursday.
- One barge, Lifttop, Cape Girardeau, Mississippi River, $500 switched, next week, bid 85 percent, no comparison, no offer.
- Four barges, Mid-Mississippi, one each week of September, bid 155 percent, down 7-1/2 percentage points from Thursday, Similar, no offer.
- Four barges, Osceola through Cairo, Mississippi, one each week of October, no bid, offer 195 percent, up 2-1/2 percentage points from Thursday.
